cohort: The study utilized data from FinnGen database and UK Biobank, including 115,082 participants with lipid measurements and 8,507 patients with preterm birth.
finding: Elevated levels of apolipoprotein B, low-density lipoprotein cholesterol, non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, remnant cholesterol, total free cholesterol, and triglycerides in low-density lipoprotein were causally associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery.
